title: To and from
summary: Say where people go with the dative `-(y)A` and where they come from with the ablative `-DAn`, with pronouns, place words and the verbs that take these cases.
canDo: Say where you are going and where you are coming from
Get on and off buses, trains and ferries
Say that a place is near or far
Ask for simple directions and follow them
vocabThemes: verbs with the dative or ablative
